market_summary: Strong USD strength driving heavy bearish breakdowns across EURUSD and GBPUSD during London/NY Overlap, supported by high RVOL and strongly negative CVD. Gold and BTC are also under pressure below VWAP/VAL but showing short-term stretch/low RVOL caution. US100 remains elevated in a bullish trend consolidated inside the upper region of its Value Area.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4039.33) and below POC (4044.58). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.21) with slight positive slope, showing divergence from the price selloff. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is below VWAP and EMA50, stretching into the lower ATR band near Session Low 4026.41 without strong RVOL surge (last RVOL 1.238). Potential liquidity sweep/exhaustion at support.
signals.level_event: rejection at lower ATR band testing Session Low 4026.41

signals.rationale: Price is well below VAL (1.11308) and POC (1.11367). CVD is strongly BEARISH (-12,533) with negative slope (-6,983), aligning with price breakdown. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP.
